mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 45, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy heads towards a potential recession.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 45 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, indicating a tight monetary policy, and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy faces a potential recession.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL rising but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are declining and retail sales (RSAFS) are also falling, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both falling but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is growing faster than 1% year-over-year, it signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS y-o-y growth > 1% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) is above 55, indicating strong manufacturing activity, and industrial production is also rising, it predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy strengthens.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is falling, it predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy is likely in a monetary easing cycle.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL falling but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.
